**Not yet.** Right now you've verified 1 of 14 checks, and "integration-tests is green" doesn't support "good to merge" in standup. *(fact)*

**Before you say it, check:**
- **All 14 checks.** Other jobs (lint, format, spec freshness, etc.) fail independently of the test job. Run `gh pr checks 482` and read every row, not just the one you've been watching.
- **Merge state.** Run `gh pr view 482 --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision,baseRefName,headRefOid`. If it's `CONFLICTING` or `DIRTY`, no new workflow runs fire. A pending or `CHANGES_REQUESTED` review also blocks the merge.
- **Latest push.** Compare `headRefOid` with `git rev-parse HEAD` to confirm the checks you're looking at ran on your latest push, not an earlier one.
- **Work account.** If the repo is under the work org, prefix with `gh auth switch -u <work-account> &&`.

**A payments-specific caveat** *(hypothesis)*: 96 green tests don't show that the retry logic is exercised. Two things are worth checking:
- Whether a test goes red when you remove or neutralize the retry.
- Whether retries on non-idempotent calls (charge or create) can double-charge. That needs an idempotency key or a retry-safe-only whitelist.

If you can't confirm those, say "integration tests pass, still verifying the rest" in standup. Once `gh pr checks 482` is all green and the review is approved, "good to merge" is accurate.

---

**Коротко по-русски:**
Ты спросил, можно ли на стендапе сказать, что PR #482 (pull request, запрос на слияние изменений) готов к мёрджу. Пока нет: ты проверил только 1 из 14 проверок (CI, автоматические проверки на PR). Прогони `gh pr checks 482`, посмотри `mergeStateStatus` и статус ревью через `gh pr view 482 --json ...`, и убедись, что проверки шли на твоём последнем пуше. Для платёжного клиента ещё проверь, что тесты реально ловят отсутствие ретраев и что повторы не приводят к двойному списанию. До этого честная формулировка: «интеграционные тесты зелёные, остальное проверяю».
